title: ARSIA Compliance Field
description: Compliance envelope field for ARSIA Protocol messages. Declares the regulatory requirements applicable to the processing of a specific message, including the compliance profile, data residency zone, audit obligations, human oversight mode, and GDPR processing basis. additionalProperties is enabled by design (ARSIA-Core.md §1.2) to allow compliance profiles to define profile-specific fields without schema changes; implementations should validate known field names at the application layer to detect typos.

profile.description: Name of the compliance profile to apply. Known profiles: GDPR-STANDARD, EU-AI-ACT-HIGH-RISK, EU-AI-ACT-LIMITED-RISK, MIFID-II, PAC-AGRICULTURE, DSA-VLOP, DORA. Unknown profile names SHOULD trigger a warning; in strict mode, unknown profiles MUST be rejected.

allOf.description: Geographic zone where message processing and storage MUST occur. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or supranational identifier. When set, triggers brokered routing (ARSIA-Routing.md §1.2.2).

audit_required.description: Whether this message MUST generate an ArsiaAuditRecord. Default: per profile. When pii_involved is true, the effective value is always true regardless of this field's declared value (Core §4.3.8, Rule 7).

retention_days.description: Number of days the audit record for this message must be retained. Overrides profile default. MUST NOT be less than the profile's minimum.

human_oversight.description: Human oversight mode. not_required: no oversight needed. required_before_execution: action MUST NOT execute until a human approves. required_within_24h: action MAY execute but human MUST review within 24 hours. required_post_execution: action executes immediately, results audited for human review.

explainability_required.description: Whether the response MUST include a payload.explanation object (ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2). Default: per profile.

pii_involved.description: Whether this message contains or processes personal data as defined by GDPR Art. 4(1). When true, legal_basis MUST be set.

legal_basis.description: GDPR legal basis for processing. Art. 6(1) grounds: consent, contract, legal_obligation, vital_interests, public_task, legitimate_interests. Art. 9(2) grounds (for sensitive data): explicit_consent, employment_social_security, vital_interests_incapacity, legitimate_activities, manifestly_public, legal_claims, substantial_public_interest, health_medicine, public_health, archiving_research. REQUIRED when pii_involved is true.

ai_system_classification.description: Per-message EU AI Act classification. MAY differ from agent-level classification (ARSIA-Identity.md §1.2) but MUST NOT exceed it.
